payload.summary: ElevenLabs Agents own the live voice loop on an ElevenLabs built-in LLM; robin-dev and robin-prod share identical settings except the post-call webhook
details: Live turns use a built-in ElevenLabs model (conversation_config.agent.prompt.llm, claude-haiku-5-5 to start); ElevenLabs holds no OpenRouter key and no custom LLM
Max tokens 150, temperature 0.8; system tool end_call enabled
Overrides enabled for system prompt and first message only; anything else overridden is rejected at session start
Authentication required: sessions start only with a WebRTC conversation token minted by POST /api/sessions (getWebrtcToken with xi-api-key)
ELEVENLABS_AGENT_ID is the dev agent locally and the prod agent on Railway
Persona name is AGENT_NAME in src/constants.ts, which is env-free so the web app and unit tests can import it
The live model is chosen by a real-call bake-off measured with `bun run report:latency --since <timestamp>` per candidate window

searchText: elevenlabs agent robin built-in llm overrides token authentication end_call latency bake-off
subject: voice.elevenlabs-agents
